notes.title: Update 2025/01/12 Freeze support, skill reordering, one-way streets clearly show

[*] Fixed a problem with freezing when updating the Steam client.
[*] Added the ability to reorder skills.

One-way streets are now displayed when there is a one-way street between adjacent squares that have already been entered.

We have also adjusted enemy ability values and skills related to hit and evasion, such as increasing the evasion (DOGE) of quick enemies such as bees.

For the shortcuts from the 1st to 3rd floor of the Road to the Goddess, we have added a room on the 3rd floor, where there is a ladder to go to the 1st floor, and at the end of the ladder, there is a lever to open the shortcuts.

If you want to use the MOD to support English, create a "language" folder directly under the area folder and enter
Please create "English_static.mgn" and "English_tmp.mgn".
The former is loaded at the start of the game and remains in memory forever. Write here anything that needs to be converted in other places, such as items or styles.
The latter is loaded when the area is entered, and the memory is freed when the area is exited. Used for things that are only used within the area, such as conversation sentences.

---
func main() {

func show() {
     // Determine here whether to enter from another area
